what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 944 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in the United States, 3.2% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the most refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999.
It also records armed conflicts over Croatia territory in 1991 and 1992 and over Slovenia territory in 1991.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 52 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 19116, at the end of 2006; the main years of displacement in the data are 1999 to 2003 and 2006.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
